title: Detaching a script extending a custom class resets all properties to default values
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7 RC1 and 4.6.2

### System information

Godot v4.7.rc1 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9649) - AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 30.88 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

If you detach a script from a node for a custom class, the properties on that node (coming from the parent class, the custom class) get reset to their default values. Insult to injury, undo doesn't return it. Happens with external scripts and built-in scripts, 100% of the times I've done it.

Only workaround I've found is to modify the scene file in a text editor to detach the script manually.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a script with a class_name, with some exported vars
- Add a node to your scene for that class
- Extend that class by doing right click -> Extend Script
- Modify the values of exported vars in the property panel of that node
- Right click the node and hit "detach script"
- Look at the properties now, observe they've been reset to their default values

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This project has been set up so you can just right click the "MyTestComponent" node -> hit Detach Script -> See the properties on the right side all get reset back to their default values. If you save without closing, you can repeat this indefinitely.

[simple-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28795718/simple-test.zip)
